results.title: UTEP football coach, family to give away 2K tickets for game vs. Nevada
results.description: EL PASO, Texas (KTSM) — UTEP head football coach Scotty Walden and his family purchased 2,000 tickets to be given away to UTEP football fans for the Miners’ Mountain West home opener against Nevada next Saturday, Oct. 10.
